motivations.constraint: Every DTCG token value and relationship must trace to source evidence and a material token experiment.
motivations.reason: A DTCG token file can be valid while remaining generic or visually weak.
motivations.failure_prevented: DTCG token output that copies defaults or accepts unseen pixels.

motivations.constraint: Every repeatable DTCG token mechanic must use one Mise task graph path.
motivations.reason: DTCG token judgment is more reliable when deterministic work produces current evidence.
motivations.failure_prevented: DTCG token changes that bypass tests, lifecycle owners, factory update mode, or lineage.

domain_failures: A DTCG token package passes structure checks but produces generic, inaccessible, or visually poor proof.
A token proof claims quality from metadata, hashes, or unviewed captures instead of current direct vision.
domain_evidence: DTCG token source locations, experiment records, conformance exits, hashes, and current rendered-pixel receipts.
Token proof decisions with counterevidence, uncertainty, scope limits, and a same-executor vision record.

actors: DTCG token authors, vision executors, reviewers, users, and package owners have named authority.
objects: DTCG token sources, values, aliases, evidence, proof artifacts, experiments, and run records have one owner.
actions: DTCG token work inventories, experiments, authors, validates, renders, judges, repairs, accepts, and restores.
states: DTCG token state distinguishes stale, pending, running, blocked, passing, accepted, rejected, restored, and retired.
invariants: DTCG token source fidelity, semantics, accessibility, evidence, authority, and visual judgment survive change.
variants: DTCG token values vary by source and context while the DTCG 2025.10 exchange contract stays stable.
interfaces: DTCG token JSON, evidence JSON, proof HTML, run JSON, Mise tasks, and evals keep tested interfaces.
authorities: DTCG token purpose and visual acceptance stay human or model owned; Mise owns repeatable mechanics only.
failures: DTCG token work can fail through generic values, false claims, stale proof, inaccessible ranges, or unseen pixels.
recoveries: DTCG token recovery repairs the lowest owner or restores the last accepted package and artifact digest.
evidence: DTCG token evidence links source locations, experiments, checks, rendered pixels, decisions, hashes, and limits.
time: DTCG token research, fonts, inputs, pixels, receipts, and lineage must be current for the active run.
resources: DTCG token tasks bound wall time, CPU, memory, storage, network, cache, context, cost, and human attention.
quality: DTCG token quality requires independent conformance, specificity, accessibility, originality, restraint, and vision gates.
terminology: DTCG token names distinguish primitive values, semantic aliases, experiments, proof scaffolds, and product templates.
exclusions: DTCG token work does not invent product facts, infer global uniqueness, proxy pixels, publish, or deploy.

research_receipts.claim: The published Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10 defines interoperable token structure, groups, types, aliases, and extensions.
research_receipts.limitations: The DTCG token format does not establish source specificity or rendered visual quality.

research_receipts.claim: WCAG 2.2 supplies measurable accessibility constraints that can veto unsafe token ranges and rendered uses.
research_receipts.limitations: WCAG conformance does not establish DTCG token originality, taste, or product-specific visual quality.

research_receipts.claim: Mise tasks provide dependency-aware execution, task discovery, aliases, and shared local and CI entry paths.
research_receipts.limitations: Mise can prove DTCG token mechanics but cannot make qualitative visual judgments.

research_receipts.claim: An agent skill uses a concise SKILL body with optional references, assets, scripts, and progressive disclosure.
research_receipts.limitations: The format specification does not define DTCG token semantics, experiments, or visual acceptance.

research_receipts.claim: Provenance links entities, activities, agents, derivation, attribution, and time for evidence records.
research_receipts.limitations: PROV-O does not define the full DTCG token run or visual judgment contract.

disconfirmation.question: Can DTCG token format conformance prove that a token system is visually good?
disconfirmation.result: No. The DTCG token standard defines an interchange format and token semantics, while rendered quality requires separate evidence and direct vision.
disconfirmation.disposition: Keep DTCG token conformance and visual acceptance as independent noncompensating gates.

token-help.motivation: DTCG token work needs one discoverable interface before state mutation.
token-help.value: The DTCG token help output exposes valid commands, arguments, exits, and examples without bypass routes.
token-help.proof: The DTCG token pipeline help exits zero and prints the complete public contract.
token-help.applicability: Run when an executor needs DTCG token command or pipeline guidance.

token-run.outcome: A DTCG token run begins with frozen input hashes and 25 initialized step records.
token-run.motivation: DTCG token evidence and decisions need durable state before work starts.
token-run.value: The DTCG token run initializer creates the closed input-to-output chain and current progress ledger.
token-run.proof: The DTCG token init receipt names the run directory, source hashes, and every pending step.
token-run.applicability: Run once when starting a new DTCG token derivation or proof run.

token-packet.outcome: One DTCG token pipeline step receives its exact inputs, outputs, support owners, and prerequisite state.
token-packet.motivation: DTCG token executors need bounded context without losing the step contract.
token-packet.value: The DTCG token packet narrows work to one eligible step and its current dependencies.
token-packet.proof: The DTCG token packet receipt lists exact paths, hashes, predecessor state, and required outputs.
token-packet.applicability: Run before executing one DTCG token pipeline step.

token-start.outcome: One eligible DTCG token step transitions from pending to running after prerequisites pass.
token-start.motivation: DTCG token state must reject out-of-order or duplicate execution.
token-start.value: The DTCG token start transition preserves one authoritative step status and start time.
token-start.proof: The DTCG token start receipt records the selected step and validated predecessor state.
token-start.applicability: Run immediately before performing an eligible DTCG token step.

token-pass.outcome: One running DTCG token step reaches PASS only after named outputs and required judgment evidence exist.
token-pass.motivation: DTCG token completion must not be inferred from intent or a status flag alone.
token-pass.value: The DTCG token pass transition binds current output hashes and visual or semantic evidence to the step.
token-pass.proof: The DTCG token pass receipt records verified outputs, evidence, and resulting step state.
token-pass.applicability: Run after completing and checking one running DTCG token step.

token-block.outcome: One DTCG token step records a typed blocker, evidence, recovery, and preserved progress.
token-block.motivation: DTCG token failures need resumable state instead of invented success or lost work.
token-block.value: The DTCG token block transition makes the exact failure and next valid action visible.
token-block.proof: The DTCG token block receipt records code, reason, recovery, and blocked step state.
token-block.applicability: Run when a DTCG token step cannot satisfy its contract.

token-status.outcome: The DTCG token run reports current step counts, blockers, and whole-run completion truthfully.
token-status.motivation: DTCG token progress must distinguish pending, running, blocked, stale, and passed work.
token-status.value: The DTCG token status readback gives an inspectable summary without mutating evidence.
token-status.proof: The DTCG token status receipt reports every state count and whether all 25 steps pass.
token-status.applicability: Run whenever current DTCG token run progress or completion must be read.

token-validate.outcome: A supplied DTCG token document receives a current conformance and reference-resolution report.
token-validate.motivation: DTCG token authors need a direct validation path for candidate files.
token-validate.value: The DTCG token validator turns schema, type, alias, extension, and cycle faults into bounded diagnostics.
token-validate.proof: The DTCG token validation receipt reports errors, warnings, and resolved token count for the supplied file.
token-validate.applicability: Run after authoring or changing a DTCG token document.

token-prove.outcome: An authored DTCG token set and its evidence become one standalone inspectable proof artifact.
token-prove.motivation: DTCG token quality decisions need a visible surface tied to exact candidate bytes.
token-prove.value: The DTCG token assembler embeds declared assets and evidence without making design judgments.
token-prove.proof: The DTCG token proof receipt names the artifact, input hashes, embedded assets, and unresolved obligations.
token-prove.applicability: Run after DTCG token validation and before direct visual acceptance.

token-explore.outcome: A DTCG token effort receives current source-backed exploration evidence and materially different strategy candidates.
token-explore.motivation: DTCG token authorship needs broad reference input and counterexamples before experiments lock values.
token-explore.value: The DTCG token exploration task records source receipts, transfer ideas, negative precedents, and experiment seeds.
token-explore.proof: The DTCG token exploration receipt identifies current sources, candidate strategies, gaps, and next experiments.
token-explore.applicability: Run before DTCG token controlled comparisons or when source evidence becomes stale.

font-prepare.outcome: A DTCG token typography experiment receives current eligible Google Font assets outside the popularity exclusion.
font-prepare.motivation: DTCG token font choices need current provenance and self-contained proof bytes.
font-prepare.value: The DTCG token font task filters the catalog, downloads selected WOFF2 data, and prepares inline CSS metadata.
font-prepare.proof: The DTCG token font receipt records catalog date, rank, source URLs, hashes, and embedded font output.
font-prepare.applicability: Run when a DTCG token typography candidate requires a current Google Font.
